name: Leis Para Todos
source:
Leis para Todos is a visual novel with puzzle and dating-sim elements about the congressman Alberto Colina, an honest politician in a Congress full of corrupt ones.

[Edited from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=897938601]Steam Greenlight[/url]]
